model_A.policy_name: NIST fit-for-purpose + COCO metrics + corruption robustness demo gate

g1_clean_map50.description: Clean reference performance must remain operationally credible on COCO-style AP50.

g2_adverse_map50.description: Performance under adverse/critical scenarios must remain above a minimum functional floor.

g3_rpc50.description: Relative performance under corruption should remain at or above 65% of clean-reference AP50.
